C. Sum of Two
time limit per test
2 seconds
memory limit per test
256 megabytes
input
standard input
output
standard output

You are given an integer n. Find two positive integers whose sum is n.

Input

The first line contains t test cases. Each test case is a single integer n (2 le n le 1000000000).

Output

For each test case, print two integers.

Examples
Input
2
4
7
Output
2 2
3 4
Input
1
6
Output
3 3
Note

Any decomposition into a sum works, but here a single fixed answer is expected.
